correctness.rationale: Exact bond percolation along unique tree paths gives a distance-polynomial expectation. Leaf-attachment plus graph-isomorphism enumerates every tree through seven vertices, checks a global minimizer with exact rational factor/root-sign tests; an eight-vertex witness has F_2-F_1=2p(p^3+p^2-1), and all other targets are provably dominated by one of the two, giving the unique interior change. Independent retained-edge enumeration verifies witness values at three rational p; all critical computations reproduced.

value.rationale: Smallest topology at which transmission intensity changes the optimal vaccine site is a natural, nontrivial exact intervention-design boundary. Complete universality through seven and a sharp algebraic eight-vertex counterexample distinguish it from generic monotonicity, textbook path-connectivity identities and arbitrarily selected graph calculations; the cutoff precisely motivates the finite census.
